other_conditions: Must be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
Must have at least one year of continuous membership in the board
Benefit can be claimed only once every three years
Must submit an undertaking specifying bicycle price, trademark, source, and purchase date
Must pay the registration fee and have at least 90 days of work experience in the preceding year
benefits_summary: Provides ₹3,000 financial assistance for the purchase of a bicycle to eligible construction workers.
